thread.title: Universal Display stock soars after report says Apple will use OLED screens in all new iPhone models next year

author: Emily Bary
title: Universal Display stock soars after report says Apple will use OLED screens in all new iPhone models next year
text: Shares of Universal Display Corp. OLED, +3.96% are up 15% in Tuesday morning trading after a report from South Korea's Economic Times indicated that Apple Inc. AAPL, -0.36% plans to put organic light-emitting diode (OLED) screens in all three of the iPhone models it will introduce next year. The report cited unnamed industry sources. Shares of LG Display Co. Ltd. LPL, +1.17% another OLED-panel maker, are up 4% in morning trading, while shares of Japan Display Inc. 6740, -7.97% which makes liquid-crystal display (LCD) screens fell 8% in Tuesday's session. Currently Apple uses OLED screens for its premium iPhone X and uses Samsung Electronics Co. 005930, -1.91% as its supplier. Apple didn't immediately respond to MarketWatch's request for comment. Apple shares are down 0.4% in Tuesday trading but up 23% over the past 12 months, while the Dow Jones Industrial Average DJIA, -1.58% has gained 17%.
